problem.title: Find the Prefix Common Array of Two Arrays
problem.problemStatement: Given two permutations of the integers from 1 to N, compute an array where the i-th element represents the number of common elements in the prefixes ending at index i.
problem.input: • First line contains integer N. • Second line contains the first permutation. • Third line contains the second permutation.
